WITH RECURSIVE chain (id, parent_id, status) AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, status FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{departmentId} UNION DISTINCT SELECT d.id, d.parent_id, d.status FROM sys_department d JOIN chain c ON d.id = c.parent_id ) SELECT status FROM chain

WITH RECURSIVE subtree (id) AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{departmentId} UNION DISTINCT SELECT d.id FROM sys_department d JOIN subtree s ON d.parent_id = s.id ) SELECT id FROM subtree
